summary: Frontend-only retest of the Laboratorio (tab maestro) discoverability fix as admin (admin@mikilab.de) on mobile viewport 390x844. Verified: (1) scroll reset on entering Laboratorio, (2) vertical landing order, (3) LabTour step sequence. RESULT: the new mount scroll-reset in Maestro.jsx works (scrollY=0 at ~400ms), BUT on the FIRST entry of each browser session a legacy auto-scroll in PianoProduzioneAI.jsx (setTimeout 500ms -> capo-source-choice.scrollIntoView) fires AFTER the reset and throws the page back to scrollY=2810, hiding 'Inserisci una Ricetta'. This is exactly the scrollY~2810 symptom reported in iteration_117 — NOT fixed for the first entry. Second and later entries (sessionStorage flag mikilab_lab_scrolled='1') land correctly at scrollY=0 with the CTA visible. Landing order PASS. Tour titles/targets order PASS with two minor scroll deviations.

ui_bugs.issue: Legacy 'snellimento' useEffect scrolls to capo-source-choice 500ms after mount (once per session, guarded by sessionStorage mikilab_lab_scrolled). It overrides the new Maestro mount reset: measured scrollY 0 @400ms -> 2779 @800ms -> 2810 @1000ms, maestro-top-aggiungi rect.top = -2504 (off-screen). First-time users therefore still land mid-page and never see 'Inserisci una Ricetta' / Percorso Guidato.

When restarted from lab-tour-replay the intro step does not scroll to top (scrollY stayed 1815), so the 'top to bottom' promise in the intro copy starts mid-page. Intro step has target:null so no scroll is performed.

lab-wizard is 1253px tall; scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) puts its header off-screen (rect.top = -205), so the highlighted 'Percorso Guidato' title is not visible during its own step. Consider block:'start' for tall targets.

Scroll is not strictly monotonic top->down: step 3 (capo-source-choice) scrolls to y=2778 then step 4 (capo-modules) scrolls back UP to y=2303, because capo-modules sits ABOVE capo-source-choice in the DOM. Either swap steps 4/3 or reorder the panels.

issues: Layout/order itself is correct: hero(absTop 81) -> maestro-top-tools(281) -> maestro-top-aggiungi(306) -> lab-wizard(551) -> PianoProduzioneAI. CTA is large and high-contrast.

action_items: Remove (or gate behind 'only when no landing reset happened') the useEffect at PianoProduzioneAI.jsx:207-216 that auto-scrolls to capo-source-choice after 500ms — it is the sole cause of the residual scrollY 2810 on first entry per session.

Optionally: scroll to top on LabTour intro step (target null), use block:'start' for tall targets like lab-wizard, and reorder tour steps so capo-modules comes after/below capo-source-choice to keep the top->down progression.
critical_code_review_comments: Two competing scroll controllers (Maestro mount reset with rAF+80ms timeout vs PianoProduzioneAI 500ms scrollIntoView) create a race; the later timer always wins. Centralize scroll intent in one place.

React hydration console error observed on the Laboratorio page: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from the PianoProduzioneAI subtree — invalid markup inside a <select>/<option>.

success_rate.frontend: 2/3 scenarios pass (first-entry scroll FAIL, later-entry scroll PASS, landing order PASS, tour order PASS with 3 minor deviations)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro requires a FRESH browser session (sessionStorage empty): login, scroll Home to bottom (scrollY ~2759), click nav-tab-maestro, then measure window.scrollY at 400ms AND at 1000ms — the regression only appears after ~700ms. Correct bottom-nav testids: nav-tab-home, nav-tab-ricette, nav-tab-maestro, nav-tab-impara, nav-tab-community (there is NO nav-tab-recipes). Tour can be forced with [data-testid='lab-tour-replay'] inside PianoProduzioneAI (Mohammadreza box).
rca_of_the_issue: Maestro.jsx:103-108 correctly forces window.scrollTo(0,0) on mount (immediate + rAF + 80ms). However PianoProduzioneAI.jsx:208-216 registers a 500ms setTimeout that calls document.querySelector('[data-testid="capo-source-choice"]').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}) unless sessionStorage 'mikilab_lab_scrolled' is set. On the first Laboratorio visit of a session this fires after the reset, scrolling to y~2810 and pushing maestro-top-aggiungi 2500px above the viewport. Fix: delete that effect (or make it run only for an explicit user intent).
